Seo.title: Masar Portal
Seo.description: Upload your visa documents, follow a personalised checklist, and get every file reviewed by Masar Center — for Study, Chancenkarte, Medical (D16), and Ausbildung applications to Germany.
Seo.keywords: Masar Portal, visa document checklist, German visa documents, study visa Germany, Chancenkarte, D16 medical visa, Ausbildung visa, Masar Center, upload visa documents

CookieConsent.title: We use cookies
CookieConsent.body: We use strictly necessary cookies to keep you signed in and remember your language — these don't need your consent under GDPR/ePrivacy. We do not currently use analytics or advertising cookies; if that ever changes, we will ask you again before doing so.

Account.title: Your account
Account.name: Name
Account.deleteBody: This permanently removes your account, every application you have started, and every document you have uploaded — including your passport. This cannot be undone.
Account.deleteConfirmQuestion: Are you sure? We will email you a link to confirm.
Account.deleteError: Could not start the deletion. Please try again.
Account.deleteSentBody: We sent you a link to confirm deleting your account. Open it in this browser while still signed in. The link expires in 1 hour.
Account.deletedBody: Your account, applications and uploaded documents have been permanently removed. Thank you for using Masar Portal.

TwoFactor.title: Two-step verification
TwoFactor.statusOn: On — a code from your authenticator app is required when you sign in.
TwoFactor.statusOff: Off — your password alone can sign you in.
TwoFactor.intro: Add a second step to signing in, using an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator or Aegis.
TwoFactor.requiredForAdmin: Two-step verification is required for staff accounts. Set it up below to reach the admin area.
TwoFactor.scanIntro: Scan this code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
TwoFactor.backupHelp: These are shown once. Each one works a single time if you lose your phone. Store them somewhere safe and not on the same device.
TwoFactor.doneHelp: You will be asked for a code from your authenticator app the next time you sign in.
TwoFactor.errorEnable: Could not start setup. Check your password and try again.
TwoFactor.errorCode: That code was not accepted. Check your authenticator app and try again.
TwoFactor.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
TwoFactor.regenerateIntro: Lost your saved codes, or used them all? Generate a new set. The old codes stop working immediately; your authenticator app is not affected.
TwoFactor.errorRegenerate: Could not generate new codes. Check your password and try again.
TwoFactor.pendingIntro: You started setting this up but never confirmed a code. Your authenticator app still holds the right secret — enter a code from it to finish.
TwoFactor.showQrIntro: Did not scan it, or scanning a different phone? Show the same QR code again.
TwoFactor.reenrolWarning: This replaces your current secret and backup codes immediately. Your existing authenticator entry and saved codes stop working the moment you continue — so only do this with the new phone in your hand, and finish by scanning and entering a code.
TwoFactor.disableWarning: Your account will be protected by your password alone. Staff accounts cannot open the admin area without two-step verification, so you would have to set it up again before returning there.
TwoFactor.errorDisable: Could not turn it off. Check your password and try again.

AppLayout.verifyBanner: Verify your email to submit an application. We sent a link to {email}.

Home.heroTitle: Your German visa documents, in one place.
Home.heroBody: Masar Center guides you through the paperwork: a checklist built for your case, a place to upload every document, and a review from our team before anything reaches the embassy.
Home.chooseCategoryBody: Each one has its own document checklist.
Home.step1Body: Study, Chancenkarte, Medical (D16) or Ausbildung — pick the one that matches your plan.
Home.step2Body: A short form, two steps. It takes about two minutes on a phone.
Home.step3Body: You get a personalised checklist. Masar reviews each file and tells you what is missing.

CategoryPicker.allTaken: You have an application in every category.

Dashboard.empty: You have not started an application yet. Choose a category below to begin.

Wizard.studentLegend: Is your programme taught in German or English?
Wizard.studentHint: If it is taught in English, you will also need an English language certificate.
Wizard.medicalHint: Doctors are asked for one extra document (بيان معاودة).
Wizard.sensitiveConsentLabel: I consent to Masar Center processing the criminal record extract and medical report I will upload for this application, as described in the
Wizard.fullNameLatinHint: Exactly as it appears in the machine-readable line of your passport.
Wizard.pointsHint: Germany gives the Opportunity Card using a points system. You need at least 6 points. Answer the questions below and your total updates as you go — you will not be able to continue below 6 points.
Wizard.pointsBasicNote: Before points are counted, you also need a completed vocational training or university degree, and either German at A1 or English at B2. Masar will check this with you.
Wizard.pointsFlagsLegend: Tick anything that is true for you
Wizard.pointsPassNote: You have enough points to apply. Reaching 6 points does not by itself guarantee an Opportunity Card — the German authorities decide, and other conditions apply. The Masar team will check your application and tell you where you stand.
Wizard.pointsFailNote: You need {needed} points to continue, so you cannot submit this application yet. Look through your answers again — people often miss points for work experience or for a qualification that is partly recognised. If you believe your score should be higher, contact Masar and we will go through it with you.
Wizard.germanLevelHint: Choose the highest level you can prove with a certificate. B2 gives the most points; A1 gives none, but it still helps you meet the basic requirement.
Wizard.englishLevelHint: Only C1 and above give a point here. B2 English gives no points, but it can help you meet the basic requirement.
Wizard.experienceHint: Only count work in a job that your own training or degree qualifies you for.

Checklist.title: Your document checklist
Checklist.lockedReview: Your application is being reviewed. Documents are locked until a decision is made.
Checklist.lockedApproved: This application has been approved. Documents are locked.
Checklist.uploadHint: PDF, JPG or PNG · up to {limit} MB per file. Photos are made smaller automatically before uploading.
Checklist.submitDeclaration: I confirm that these documents are mine, that the information I have given is accurate, and that I have read the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.
Checklist.uploadFailed: The upload did not complete. Please check your connection and try again.
Checklist.tooLargeToSend: This file is too large to upload. Please use a file smaller than {limit} MB — try compressing the PDF or scanning at a lower quality.
Checklist.deleteApplicationWarning: This permanently deletes this application and every document uploaded to it. This cannot be undone.

ApplicationCard.documentsUploaded: {count, plural, one {# document uploaded} other {# documents uploaded}}

NewApplication.intro: Next you'll answer two short questions, then get your document checklist. You can stop at any point and continue later — nothing is sent to Masar until you submit.
NewApplication.verifyFirst: Confirm your email address before starting an application. Check your inbox — you can resend the message from your dashboard.

Signup.errorPasswordLength: Password must be at least 8 characters long
Signup.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.

Signup.errorSocialGeneric: Google sign-in failed. Please try again.
Signup.checkInboxBody: If {email} isn't already registered, we've sent a verification link to it. Click the link to verify your address, then sign in.

Login.title: Login to your account
Login.errorEmail: Please enter a valid email address
Login.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
Login.errorAccountNotLinked: An account with this email already exists but hasn't been verified yet. Log in with your password and verify your email first — then Google sign-in will work automatically.

ForgotPassword.title: Reset your password
ForgotPassword.intro: Enter the email address you signed up with and we will send you a link to set a new password.
ForgotPassword.sentBody: If an account exists for {email}, we have sent a reset link. Please check your inbox and your spam folder.

ResetPassword.invalidBody: This password reset link is invalid or has expired.
ResetPassword.title: Set a new password
ResetPassword.errorPasswordLength: Password must be at least 8 characters long
ResetPassword.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
ResetPassword.errorFallback: This link is invalid or has expired. Please request a new one.

VerifyEmail.expiredBody: Verification links are valid for 7 days. Log in with your email and password, then use the "Resend email" button to get a new one.
VerifyEmail.invalidBody: This verification link is malformed or has already been used. Log in and use the "Resend email" button if you still need to verify.
VerifyEmail.verifiedBody: Your email address has been verified. Please sign in to continue.

Resend.errorFallback: Could not send the email. Please try again.

SignOut.error: You are still signed in — sign-out did not complete. Please try again.

TwoFactor.title: Two-step verification
TwoFactor.codeHelp: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
TwoFactor.backupHelp: Enter one of the backup codes you saved when you set this up — exactly as shown, including the hyphen and capital letters. Each one works only once.
TwoFactor.useBackup: Lost your phone? Use a backup code
TwoFactor.errorCode: That code was not accepted. Please try again.
TwoFactor.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
TwoFactor.errorLocked: Too many failed attempts — this account is locked for a few minutes. Wait, then try again with a fresh code from your authenticator app.
